title: Azure SQL
description: Deploy and manage SQL Server in Azure with Azure SQL Database, Managed Instance, and cloud-native features.
longDescription: This module covers Azure SQL services including Azure SQL Database (single database and elastic pools), Azure SQL Managed Instance, and SQL Server on Azure Virtual Machines. You will learn deployment options, connectivity, security, monitoring, and cost management in the Azure cloud.
whatYouLearn: Deploy Azure SQL Database single databases and elastic pools
Configure Azure SQL Managed Instance for near-full SQL Server compatibility
Implement Azure SQL security with firewall rules, Azure AD authentication, and encryption
Monitor Azure SQL with built-in intelligence and Azure Monitor
Compare Azure SQL Database vs Managed Instance vs SQL VM for workload fit
